description: App updates: the scoretable window (loaded from the built-in server on http://localhost) may read the update status, ask for a check, change the two update settings and ask to restart into a downloaded update. Whether it may install is decided in Rust (updater.rs: no live match, no tablets, no tablet network). The updater plugin's own commands are NOT granted to any window. LAN tablets and the scoresheet windows never get these commands.
